title: Lost in Translation? Translation Errors and Challenges for Fair Assessment of Text-to-Image Models on Multilingual Concepts

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting text-to-image models with tangible concepts translated into multiple languages (e.g., Spanish, Japanese, Chinese) and evaluating the outputs by computing a cross-consistency score, which measures the CLIP feature cosine similarity between images generated from the test language and those generated from the source language (English).
